summary: Build enterprise budgets, assess agricultural credit risk, and structure value-chain finance. Enrol in this practical agribusiness finance course.
lede: Agribusiness finance connects seasonal production and value-chain activity with funding, cash-flow planning, and credit assessment. For agricultural lenders, relationship managers, investment officers, and agribusiness finance managers, the training supports commercially grounded funding decisions by building seasonal cash-flow forecasts, calculating working-capital needs, and testing repayment capacity. Participants also assess borrower risk using enterprise budgets and the 5 Cs of credit, and map value-chain finance flows and collateral controls.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who allocate, manage, assess, or mobilize capital across commercial agriculture and agricultural value chains.
modules: Lender Reporting and Finance Action Plans
prerequisites: You should have working exposure to agricultural, cooperative, lending, investment, development finance, or agribusiness operations. Basic financial statement reading and spreadsheet familiarity will help, but advanced accounting, programming, and credit-modelling experience are not required. Coding is not required for completion. AI-assisted credit scoring and digital dashboards are introduced at the operational awareness level, while Excel-based budgeting and cash-flow exercises receive hands-on practice. Bring a laptop with spreadsheet software if available.
